answer: Audit the arrival clock, not the paperwork: the ledger timestamps each new key's first three transactions and fingerprints inter-arrival deltas, gas choices and retry jitter. A scripted operator deploying a fleet stamps a metronomic signature, like stones dropped at even intervals into the same river; genuinely separate agents drift the way a falcon banks unpredictably on thermals. When many fresh identities share one rhythmic fingerprint, weight is held back until each shows arrival noise no sibling can imitate, and the fable of a hundred independents collapses into one hand.
